title: School Uniforms
text:
Many people think that students should wear school uniforms. In my opinion, uniforms are a good idea. First, they are cheaper than normal clothes, so parents do not spend much money. Second, students do not need to choose clothes every morning. This saves time.

However, some students believe that uniforms take away personal style. They think everyone should be free to express themselves. I agree that style is important, but I think school is a place to learn, not a fashion show. So, I believe uniforms are useful for most schools.

questions.text: According to the writer, why are school uniforms good for parents?
options: They are cheaper than normal clothes
They are made of expensive cloth
They are sold only in big shops
They are required by the government

questions.text: What do some students believe about uniforms?
options: They are only for small children

questions.text: What can you infer about the writer's view of school?
options: The writer thinks school should be more about learning than fashion
The writer thinks fashion is the most important part of school
The writer dislikes all kinds of clothes
The writer wants students to choose new clothes every day

questions.text: Why does the writer mention saving time in the first paragraph?
options: To show that uniforms make daily life easier
To show that uniforms are old-fashioned
To say that students are often late
To explain how to buy new clothes

vocabulary.definition: clothes that all members of a group or school wear
belonging to or connected with one particular person
to show your thoughts or feelings

paragraph_translations: Багато людей думають, що учні повинні носити шкільну форму. На мою думку, форма — гарна ідея. По-перше, вона дешевша за звичайний одяг, тому батьки не витрачають багато грошей. По-друге, учням не потрібно щоранку вибирати одяг. Це заощаджує час.

Однак деякі учні вважають, що форма забирає особистий стиль. Вони думають, що кожен повинен мати змогу виражати себе. Я згоден, що стиль важливий, але вважаю, що школа — це місце для навчання, а не показ мод. Тому я вважаю, що форма корисна для більшості шкіл.
